blueprint.name: AI Receptionist Agency
blueprint.description: Done-for-you AI phone receptionist agency for local appointment-based service businesses (auto, HVAC, home services). Clients = the shops you onboard.

stages.name: Lead / Qualify
stages.description: A prospect shop, not yet qualified. Confirm fit before investing time.

checklist.text: Confirm phone-driven, enough call volume, can afford ~$1k/mo
Log lead and source
Disqualify politely if not a fit (protect your time)

stages.name: Missed-Call Audit
stages.description: Measure the prospect's real missed/after-hours call volume. The wedge — their own numbers sell the deal.

checklist.text: Get phone-system / VoIP log access, or set up a tracking number
Grant access to call data / Google Business Profile
Run 1-2 week measurement of missed + after-hours calls
Produce one-page 'what last month cost you' report

stages.name: Discovery & Demo
stages.description: Walk the owner through their own audit numbers and demo a live agent on their shop's flow.

checklist.text: Walk owner through their measured leak (dollar figure)
Capture avg ticket, close rate, hot-job rules, tech stack
Build + run a live demo agent on their shop
Attend the discovery / demo call

stages.name: Proposal & Close
stages.description: Translate findings into a tiered proposal anchored to the measured leak. No build until paid.

checklist.text: Send tiered proposal anchored to the measured leak
Present overflow/after-hours-only start (no downside)
Sign the services agreement
Pay setup fee + first month (gate: no build until paid)

stages.name: Onboarding & Build
stages.description: Collect assets and configure + test the agent. Reliability is the product — this stage is where it's won.

checklist.text: Complete onboarding form: hours, services, pricing, FAQs, hot-job rules
Grant calendar + phone-routing access
Clone vertical agent template + inject the build spec
Wire booking + CRM logging + guardrails + missed-call text-back
Run full test script - zero booking errors before launch

stages.name: Launch & Stabilize
stages.description: Go live on overflow/after-hours only, watch closely, and bank the first proof.

checklist.text: Configure overflow / after-hours call forwarding (number unchanged)
Go live + run the 48-hour active watch
Daily call-log scan for the first 2 weeks
Confirm first recovered-jobs data point

stages.name: Live — ROI & Retention
stages.description: Active client. Prove ROI monthly so renewal is automatic, and expand the account.

checklist.text: Send the monthly ROI report (calls caught, jobs booked, revenue recovered)
Monthly check-in + surface an upsell
Weekly QA / drift review on the agent
Ask for a referral after a strong month

emailTemplates.name: Audit Request Welcome
emailTemplates.subject: Let's measure what your phone is costing you, {{client_name}}
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

Thanks for the interest. Before I pitch you anything, I'd like to simply measure what {{company_name}}'s phone is actually costing you right now — how many calls go missed or after-hours, and what that's worth.

Reply here and I'll get the quick audit set up. No charge, no obligation.

— {{workspace_name}}

emailTemplates.name: Audit Report Ready
emailTemplates.subject: Your missed-call numbers are in
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

I finished measuring {{company_name}}'s calls. The short version: you're leaving real money on the table every month to voicemail and after-hours.

I've put your numbers on one page and I'd love to walk you through them — and let you hear a version of an answering agent built for your shop. When works for a quick call?

— {{workspace_name}}

emailTemplates.name: Proposal Follow-up
emailTemplates.subject: Still losing those after-hours calls?
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

Just circling back on the proposal. Every week we wait, more calls go to voicemail at {{company_name}}.

Quick reminder: we start on overflow and after-hours only, so there's no downside — worst case you're exactly where you are now, best case you recover jobs. Happy to answer any questions.

— {{workspace_name}}

emailTemplates.name: Onboarding Asset Request
emailTemplates.subject: A few quick things to get you live
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

Welcome aboard! To build your agent I need a few details from you — your hours, services and rough pricing, your most common questions, and access to your calendar.

The fastest way is your client portal: {{portal_url}}. Knock those out and we'll have you live within the week.

— {{workspace_name}}

emailTemplates.name: You're Live
emailTemplates.subject: {{company_name}} is live — here's what to expect
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

Your AI receptionist is live and catching your overflow and after-hours calls. Your number hasn't changed — we're just making sure nothing rolls to voicemail.

I'll be watching closely the first couple of days. You'll get a text whenever a high-value job comes in, and a full report at the end of the month.

— {{workspace_name}}

emailTemplates.name: Monthly ROI Report
emailTemplates.subject: What we caught for {{company_name}} this month
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{client_name}},

Here's your month: the calls we answered, the jobs we booked, and the revenue we recovered that would otherwise have gone to voicemail.

Anything sounding off on calls, or any service/price change I should load? And if it's been a good month — who else do you know losing calls the way you were?

— {{workspace_name}}
